Definition: One-based row order in the printed supplementary table
Species or subspecies label exactly as printed; no modern taxonomic reassignment
Note: Historical labels and subspecies are retained.

Definition: Analysis taxon label, currently identical to species_as_published
Note: No taxonomic harmonization has been applied.

Definition: Number of contributing studies in the species moderator analysis; not animal sample size
Note: Do not interpret as number of individuals.

Definition: Coordinated bimanual task category from table caption
Note: Tube task and other tasks are separate analyses.

Definition: Signed MHI or absolute MABSHI from table caption
Note: Signed direction and unsigned strength are different traits.

Definition: Published species moderator point estimate; dimensionless handedness index scale
Note: Meta-analytic value, not a primary individual or study mean; retained even if out of scale.

Definition: Published lower bound of 95% confidence interval
Note: May exceed theoretical index scale in source.

Definition: Published upper bound of 95% confidence interval
Note: May exceed theoretical index scale in source.

Definition: Published p-value string, including less-than sign and decimal comma
Numeric value printed for p, or upper bound when operator is <
Note: <0,001 becomes operator < and bound 0.001; not an exact p value.

Definition: TRUE when signed point is outside [-1,1] or absolute point outside [0,1]
Note: Source anomaly flag; value is not altered.

Definition: TRUE when any printed confidence bound is outside the theoretical index scale
Note: Source anomaly flag; confidence interval is not altered.

Definition: Species-level moderator estimate from multiple or single study samples
Secondary meta-analysis; underlying samples may occur in other compilations
Note: Do not independently pool with Caspar or Püschel rows.
